description: Beautiful luminous house with nice volumes !Close to Paris, you will be able to quickly access the events of the Olympic Games. When you return, you can enjoy the calm of the garden and its terrace.The spaceThe 170 m² house is composed as follows:Between - ground:2 bedrooms, a shower room, washing machineGround floor :An entrance, a toilet with hand basin and cloakroom, a dining room open to the fitted kitchen A few steps provide access to a spacious and bright living room thanks to its large glass roof and which gives access to the terrace and the gardenOn the first floor -A large cathedral bedroom with a bunk bed and a 3rd bed, a large shower and a sinkA large games room with reading corner and 2 offices, one of which is equipped with a screenOn the second floor - the master suiteA large air-conditioned bedroom open to the bathroomview of the Eiffel Tower and La DéfenseThe gardenYou can enjoy the garden and the terrace, not overlooked. Very wooded, it makes us forget that we are in Paris. A Weber charcoal BBQ will be at your disposal. The table can accommodate 8 peopleThe house also has a parking space at the front of the houseOther things to noteClose to most of the Olympic events :35mn walk then train from Champs Elysée / Place de la concorde / Grand Palais : fencing / taekwondo / BMX / Skateboard / Beach Volley25mn walk from U Arena : swimming and water-polo15mn walk from Yves Du Manoir : Hockey25mn drive from Aubervilliers / Stade De France : AthleticsRegistration details9202500067115
